title: EMT set-screw connector, 3/4 in trade size

sources.citation: game-design: unverified (recalled, not read in this PR). The outside diameter (0.922 in = 23.42 mm) and nominal wall (0.049 in = 1.24 mm) of 3/4 trade size electrical metallic tubing as commonly published by makers for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 EMT (cited by number only; no NEC Chapter 9 table is used). electrical-realism-reviewer to check against a manufacturer dimension sheet, then relabel real-world. game-design: unverified. A steel set-screw EMT connector: a 25 mm body outside the enclosure wall, 34 mm across its locknut and gland, and a 11 mm threaded throat with its locknut inside the wall, which fits a knockout of its trade size (common practice; dimensions not read from a product sheet).
